title: Gadget Market — Gadgets & Tech Accessories
tagline: A dark, spec-first gadget shop with comparison and a gadget finder, fully working in your browser
description: The customer side of Gadget Market, a Dhaka shop for earbuds, smartwatches, power banks, chargers, cables, gaming and smart-home gear: filter by what it works with (iPhone, Android, USB-C, PS5…), real spec sheets, a side-by-side spec comparison, a gadget finder that picks one in-stock essential per shelf for your device and budget, combo bundles with the real saving, an honest Deal of the Day countdown and a warranty badge with the terms next to it. This is the shop's real code running in the browser — orders you place here appear in the Gadget Market admin demo.
highlights: Filter by "works with": iPhone, Android, USB-C, laptop, PS5, Switch and more
Spec comparison of 2–3 products, differences highlighted
Gadget finder: pick your device and a budget, get one essential from each shelf
Deal of the Day ends when it says — stock counts are the real ones
Warranty claims from an order line, checked against the serial and end date
Checkout fills Division → District → Upazila with a live delivery fee from Dhaka
Phone check at checkout: the SMS code appears on screen in the demo
Coupons GADGET100 and COMBO5 work at checkout
Orders you place show up in the admin demo — it is one working system
Optional shopper sign-in: 01700000001 / demo12345 — nothing is charged or delivered, and ?demo-reset starts fresh
